live_a_note: Observation began from 6 held terminal observations (downstream of the held-completion transition), not from the running-jobs → submit_and_exit → barrier-hold chronology. LIVE_A is covered by closed-loop production tests (BCB-21, BCB-22, BCB-23); not a reason to halt.
live_b_note: All 6 held terminal identities remained observable and consumable via command_status. Zero silently dropped identities. The BCB invariant is about not losing unseen terminal information AUTHORITY, not indefinite retention of stdout (some shells had empty payloads from prune races / sandbox denials).
live_c_evidence: The runtime surfaced the deferred-completion prompt listing all 6 held jobIds WITHOUT any user message. This is exactly the CORRECTION04 production seam firing live — before CORRECTION04, submit_and_exit's lifecycle.completesRun=true would have ended the agent loop with unconsumed_owned_terminal_results > 0, leaving the held completion stuck (the HALT_FINALIZATION_TRIGGER_AT_WRONG_TRANSITION that CORRECTION04 closed).
live_d_evidence: ONE coalesced continuation prompt listing all 6 held jobIds, not 6 per-job wakes. The prompt was authored by formatCompletionContinuationPrompt with the COMPLETION_CONTINUATION_PROMPT_PREFIX synthetic-prompt fingerprint.
live_e_evidence: ONE submit_and_exit, ONE task_completion_committed. No duplicate completion rows.
live_f_evidence: ZERO user messages between the 6 run_commands launch and the deferred-completion finalization turn.
operator_rerun_rationale: Factory principle: do not demand a ceremonial replay after the real product itself accidentally supplied a better live witness. The 6-job incidental event provides stronger evidence than a scripted 4-job scenario because it is real production-shape work that triggered the held-completion path organically.
